about: Visa rules for Indian ordinary passport holders, summarised from research on 16 October 2026. Each record links its sources. Rules change often.

visaKeys.OT: Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea visa

records.name: Brunei
records.rule: Visa required. Apply before travel at the Brunei High Commission in New Delhi (single entry, about B$20, 30 days).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Indonesia
records.rule: e-VOA or visa on arrival, 30 days, about IDR 500,000.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Vietnam
records.rule: e-visa, up to 90 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Cambodia
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 30 days, about US$36.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Laos
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 30 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Sri Lanka
records.rule: Free ETA or visa on arrival, 30 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.rule: Visa-free, 90 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Bangladesh
records.rule: Visa required in advance, no visa on arrival. Government fee waived for Indians, small service charge. Tourist visa issuance was reported paused in early 2026 and resuming in October 2026, so confirm it is open. The Ministry of External Affairs has a standing advisory against travel there.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Bhutan
records.rule: No visa, but an entry permit (free, online or at the border) and a Sustainable Development Fee of INR 1,200 per person per night, fixed to Aug 2027.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Oman
records.rule: Visa required. 14-day visa on arrival only with a valid US, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan or Schengen visa; otherwise e-visa. Needs return ticket, hotel booking and health insurance.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Bahrain
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 14 days; on arrival for holders of a valid UAE, UK, US, Saudi or Schengen visa.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Saudi Arabia
records.rule: India is not on the official tourist e-visa list. An e-visa or visa on arrival is for holders of a valid US, UK or Schengen visa; otherwise embassy visa or the package-visa pilot (about SAR 4,000 minimum). Sources disagree, so confirm before planning.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Jordan
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 30 days. The Jordan Pass waives the visa fee only for a stay of 2 or more nights.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Kazakhstan
records.rule: Visa-free, 14 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Kyrgyzstan
records.rule: e-visa, up to 60 days. Expect an invitation-letter step after applying.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Uzbekistan
records.rule: 30 days visa-free only with a valid multiple-entry visa from the US, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan or South Korea and an onward air ticket (rule from 1 Sep 2026); the stay must fall within that visa. Otherwise e-visa, about US$25 for one month.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Azerbaijan
records.rule: e-visa, 30 days (airport kiosk about US$30; prior e-visa for land borders).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Armenia
records.rule: e-visa, 90 days; visa on arrival with a valid visa from the EU/Schengen, US, UK, Canada or Japan.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Japan
records.rule: e-visa for people residing in India, tourism, single entry, up to 90 days, through authorised agencies.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Taiwan
records.rule: Visa required, but a free online Travel Authorization Certificate (14 days) is available with a visa or residence card from the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, South Korea or a Schengen state that is valid or expired under 10 years ago.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Philippines
records.rule: Visa-free 14 days for tourism; 30 days with a valid US, Schengen, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan or Singapore visa. Needs hotel booking, proof of funds and an onward ticket.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Switzerland
records.rule: Schengen visa required (one visa covers about 29 countries; multiple entry advised). Apply 3 to 6 months ahead. Entry/Exit System biometric registration is live since 10 Apr 2026.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Kosovo
records.rule: Visa required for Indian passports. Exempt for up to 15 days with a valid multiple entry Schengen visa or Schengen residence permit per Kosovo MFA as quoted by Wikipedia. Register address with police within 3 days. Check US or UK visa easing with Kosovo MFA before relying on it.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Bulgaria
records.rule: Schengen visa required. Bulgaria is a full Schengen member since 1 Jan 2025 (land borders), so a valid Schengen short stay visa covers entry. 90 days in 180 shared across the area. Standard Schengen fee 90 euro, about 15 days processing.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Romania
records.rule: Schengen visa required. Romania is a full Schengen member since 1 Jan 2025 (land borders), so a valid Schengen short stay visa covers entry. 90 days in 180 shared across the area. Standard Schengen fee 90 euro, about 15 days processing.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Cyprus
records.rule: EU but not Schengen. National visa required, but a valid double or multiple entry Schengen C visa (or Bulgarian, Croatian, Romanian national visa) gives entry up to 90 days in 180. Days in Cyprus do not count in Schengen. US or UK visa does not ease entry.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Saint Lucia
records.rule: Visa on arrival up to 6 weeks per MEA and Wikipedia, but the Saint Lucia government portal still lists a visa for some nationalities (EC$125 single, EC$190 multiple, 5 working days, return ticket, hotel proof). Confirm with airline before flying.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
records.rule: Visa not required. MEA says 30 days (tourist and business, no extension), Wikipedia says 3 months; officers decide on arrival. Need passport valid 6 months, return ticket, accommodation proof, funds.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Grenada
records.rule: Visa not required, 90 days per MEA (Wikipedia says 3 months). Need passport valid 6 months and return or onward ticket. Check for an airline requested electronic immigration form before travel.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Dominica
records.rule: Visa not required, up to 180 days per MEA (Wikipedia says 6 months). Need passport, return ticket, accommodation proof and funds. Ferry arrivals from Guadeloupe, Martinique or Saint Lucia clear immigration with an entry form.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Malaysia
records.rule: Indian ordinary passport: visa exempt for up to 30 days (tourism, business, social visit, transit) until 31 Dec 2026. Needs passport valid 6 months, return ticket, accommodation proof. Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC) must be filed online within 3 days before landing, free. Work or study needs a visa. Rule ends 31 Dec 2026 unless renewed: trips spanning January 2027 are UNCERTAIN; a paid eVisa fallback (RM 100 reported by a secondary site) is UNVERIFIED.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Singapore
records.rule: ICA lists India among nationalities that need a valid entry visa; apply online through the ICA Entry Visa e-service via a Singapore based authorised agent; SG Arrival Card (SGAC) free, submit within 3 days before arrival. Stay is set by e-Pass at the checkpoint (commonly 30 days, UNVERIFIED). Visa fee about SGD 30 to 40 plus agent charge, UNVERIFIED. No easing found for a US, UK, Schengen or Canada visa, UNVERIFIED. Transit without visa rules not checked.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Nepal
records.rule: No visa for Indian citizens. Carry a valid passport or Election Commission voter ID card (government photo ID also accepted per old MHA guidance); persons above 65 and below 15 exempt from ID with other photo document; air entry requires ID. No fee. Stay limit and registration after long stays UNVERIFIED. Nepal bans larger INR notes (INR 200 and above per older guidance, UNVERIFIED): carry INR 100 notes or less, or use cards, UPI is partly usable.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Thailand
records.rule: From 15 Sep 2026 Indian ordinary passport holders get 30 days visa free for tourism (previously 60 days). Extension once by up to 30 days at immigration, fee reported 1,900 THB. Visa exempt land border entries capped at 2 per calendar year. Entered before 15 Sep keeps the 60 days stamped. Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) free, submit within 3 days before arrival (beware copycat sites). Visa on arrival no longer applies to India. Onward ticket and funds can be asked.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: South Korea
records.rule: Indian ordinary passport: Korean short stay visa (C-3-9) needed. K-ETA exemption (to 31 Dec 2026) covers only 22 listed jurisdictions (US, Canada, Singapore, UK, Germany etc.), not India; K-ETA is for visa free nationals only. Visa fee INR 3,600 single entry to 90 days, INR 8,100 multiple (effective 1 Aug 2026, via visa application centre, plus service charge about INR 1,100). Processing about 10 working days. Group tourist visa route also exists. e-Arrival Card online before arrival. Easing by US, UK, Schengen or Canada visa for Indians: UNVERIFIED, not found. Visa free Jeju not available to Indians (UNVERIFIED).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Canada
records.rule: Indian citizens need a Temporary Resident Visa (visitor visa), CAD 100 plus biometrics CAD 85 (valid 10 years; family cap CAD 170); stay up to 6 months; processing reported about 3 to 8 weeks (secondary sites). eTA is not available to Indian passport holders: the conditional eTA list (valid US visa or recent Canadian visa) covers 17 countries and does not include India, so a valid US visa does NOT waive the Canadian visa for Indians. Single and multiple entry visas decided by officer; may need ITRs and funds proof.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: United States of America
records.rule: B1/B2 visitor visa needed (stay set by CBP up to 6 months). MRV application fee about USD 185 (not re-verified today, UNVERIFIED); a new USD 250 Visa Integrity Fee was enacted 4 Jul 2025 and collection start was uncertain through 2026 (UNCERTAIN, check consulate). Visa bond pilot (USD 5,000 to 15,000) covers designated countries; India not listed in snippets found, UNVERIFIED; the programme was formalised by a Federal Register rule dated 3 Aug 2026. Apply in country of residence/nationality; interview waiver rules tightened (UNVERIFIED). US consular exchange rate 98 INR per USD from 25 May 2026. ESTA not available for Indians. Wait times for appointments vary.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: United Arab Emirates
records.rule: Standard route: pre-arranged tourist e-visa (30 days single entry about USD 90 via airline/agent, 60 days about USD 177 per Emirates table, 96 hour transit USD 49, 48 hour USD 10). Conditional visa on arrival for Indian ordinary passport holders: 14 days AED 100, extendable once 14 days for AED 250; or 60 day AED 250 non extendable (Envoy), requires valid US visa or green card, UK residence permit or EU residence permit (official GDRFA/UAE embassy wording is green card or residence permit; some secondary sites say visa), documents valid 6 months, confirmed return ticket. Canada, Singapore, Japan, Korea, Australia, NZ: only residence permit qualifies, not a visitor visa. Schengen visa only: UNCERTAIN, probably does not qualify; confirm with airline. Indians with such eligibility may also apply online pre-arrival (GDRFA service fee AED 253).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Georgia
records.rule: Indian citizens need a visa unless they hold a valid visa or residence permit from US, UK, Schengen, Canada (and Australia, Japan, Korea, NZ, Israel, Ireland, GCC states per secondary lists): then visa free up to 90 days in any 180 days. Qualifying visa must be valid at entry. Otherwise eVisa at evisa.gov.ge: consular fee from USD 20 plus DuVerify step USD 15 (total about USD 35; secondary source), minimum about 5 working days. From 1 Jan 2026 tourists must hold health/accident insurance (minimum cover reported inconsistently: GEL 30,000 vs USD 30,000, UNCERTAIN).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Germany
records.rule: Schengen short stay (type C) visa required, up to 90 days in any 180 days. Fee EUR 90 (about INR 9,590) plus visa centre service charge about INR 400 to 3,125 and travel insurance (about EUR 30,000 cover). Apply 6 months to 15 days before travel at the consulate or VFS/other centre; apply at the country of main destination. A US, UK or Canada visa does NOT waive the Schengen visa for Indians. records.rule: Indian passport holders get a visa on arrival, not free entry. Book an approved hotel on the Discover Qatar site before travel (India is on the mandatory list), then pay the QAR 100 fee (about INR 2,600) at the airport, or apply in advance for a Hayya A1 e-visa. Passport valid 3 months, confirmed return ticket. Transit: Qatar Airways passengers with a layover of 6 hours or more who are not visa-free can get a transit visa at the Discover Qatar Transit Desk in Hamad airport. A traveller reports that a Hayya visa was needed for a transit stay beyond 12 hours (first-hand report, not yet confirmed on an official page). Earlier text here claiming free 30-day entry for Indians came from a secondary site and was wrong.
